title: OAuth2 Flows Deep Dive
description: Master OAuth2 authorization flows including Authorization Code, PKCE, Client Credentials, and Device Code flows.
longDescription: This module covers OAuth2 authorization flows in depth including Authorization Code flow, Authorization Code with PKCE, Client Credentials flow, Device Authorization flow, and Refresh Token flows. You will learn when to use each flow, how to implement them securely, and common pitfalls to avoid.
whatYouLearn: Implement Authorization Code flow with proper state and nonce handling
Use PKCE for public clients and mobile applications
Apply Client Credentials flow for machine-to-machine authentication
Implement Device Authorization flow for IoT and CLI applications
Design secure refresh token strategies with rotation and revocation
